delivery.min_size: 1440x1080 (larger same-ratio is fine - it will be rescaled)
delivery.no_border: do NOT include a border/frame - it gets cropped off otherwise
delivery.cropping_warning: cover-fit display can crop the outer ~5% on odd window sizes; keep beasts' faces inboard of the outer 8%

art_direction: TWO-LAYER MODEL: this image is only the environment layer. Claude Code composites the interface dressing (card sockets, recessed panels, gold hairline frame, gems) on top afterwards - so paint atmosphere ONLY in the non-essential areas and leave every keep-blank zone as plain dark stone.
Painterly torch-lit dungeon vault: smooth ashlar stone, fine cracks, near-black exposure, strong vignette.
DO NOT paint: a border frame, corner gems, card slots, board grid lines, panels, banners with text, or any text - all of that is added in post and baked-in versions fight the composite.
Faction lighting stays: warm ember light on the red/opponent side, cold sapphire light on the blue/player side, braziers as the visible sources.

Beast statuary is welcome ONLY inside the beast_features boxes: carved weathered stone (not living creatures), rim-lit by the nearest brazier, gazing toward the board area. Keep them darker than the flames so they read second, not first.
keep_blank_zones_note: Every ui_occlusion_zones box must stay plain dark stone. The board zone is the most important: no painted grid this time - Claude Code lays the gold grid and ornamental board frame in post, so a baked-in grid would ghost.

beast_features.style: Carved stone statue, weathered and chipped, part of the architecture - NOT a living creature. Lit only by rim light from the nearest brazier; silhouette readable, details dissolving into shadow.

placements.subject: dragon statue coiled around the far-left column, ember-red rim light
unicorn statue rearing on the far-right edge beyond the panel area, cold sapphire rim light

beast_features.rule: beasts stay entirely inside their zone_pct boxes and never overlap a keep-blank zone
